name: ZCC_TB_AGENT_SESSION
description: This table stores association between COD user and fusion application user using COD agent name, Party Id and Session Id.

columns.name: TB_AGENT_SESSION_ID
columns.description: Primary Key.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: Session id for current agent session.

columns.name: AGENT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party Id for loggedin agent.

columns.name: AGENT_NAME
columns.description: Agent name.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATE
columns.description: Current media state for agent.

columns.name: CONNECT_STATE
columns.description: Connected state to connector.

columns.name: ACTIVE_SLOT
columns.description: Slot number for currently active(in focus) slot. default is none.

columns.name: BREAK_REASON
columns.description: BREAK_REASON

columns.name: SUPPRESS_SCREENPOP_FLAG
columns.description: SUPPRESS_SCREENPOP_FLAG

columns.name: CURR_STATE_START_TIME_CLIENT
columns.description: The desktop time where current state was started. Can be used to maintain timers.

columns.name: LOGIN_TIME_CLIENT
columns.description: Local time on desktop when agent logged in. Can be used to maintain timers.

columns.name: LOGOUT_TIME_CLIENT
columns.description: Local time on desktop when agent logged out. Can be user to maintain timers.

columns.name: APP_WINDOW_NAME
columns.description: Window name for application window (if needed for reconnection)

columns.name: CONNECTOR_WINDOW_NAME
columns.description: Window name of Connector Window

columns.name: CHAT_WINDOW_NAME
columns.description: Stores name of Chat Window (if needed)

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
